description: Groups multiple INotionCommand instances into a single undo/redo step. Commands run in insertion order in ExecuteAsync and are reversed last-to-first in UndoAsync. NotionCommandStack builds one internally while a batch scope is open, but it can also be constructed directly and pushed as one atomic command.

members.name: Description
members.description: Human-readable label for the whole batch, shown in undo/redo affordances.

members.name: Count
members.description: Number of commands currently in the batch.

members.name: Add
members.description: Appends a command. The command must NOT have been executed yet.

members.name: ExecuteAsync
members.description: Runs every command in insertion order.

members.name: UndoAsync
members.description: Undoes every command in reverse (last-to-first) order.
